_doc: RECOG640 (2026-11-04): recognition model profiles for dpu_rx / kv2_chain.sh, selected by RECOG_MODEL (default below). Resolved by recog_args.py. Class order is fixed: 0 cup / 1 bottle / 2 banana / 3 laptop / 4 backpack / 5 medicine box.

y8s640.desc: dev3 round-4 YOLOv8s 6-class QAT epoch-1, square 640 letterbox (owner 11-04: product default)

y8s640r.desc: RESERVED: dev3 640x480 rectangular re-quantisation of the same QAT weights (not delivered yet). Fill xmodel / xmodel_sha256 / thresholds_json / thresholds_sha256 / fix from the delivery and set ready=true. Pre-processing = PREP1 rectangular target 640x480 (content 640x480, bypass, no square pad); post-processing grids 80x60 / 40x30 / 20x15. dpu_rx still assumes a square tensor (Geometry.size): see RUN/RECOG640/README.md 'unfinished'.

y8s512.desc: previous product model: dev3 round-2 PTQ YOLOv8s 6-class 512 (LeakyReLU), DPUPIPE1 output processing (single conf 0.25 before NMS, no max_det)
